purpose: Teach: 南東/電電/ヴォーカル/長調/小麦粉/エッセー/豪快/マーカー

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「南東向きの窓から朝日を見よう」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was saying, 'Let's watch the morning sun from the southeast window.'
lines.style: Brisk warmth softening into the quote, gentle mother's cadence, small smile on morning sun.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと電電公社時代のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, me and Dad watched a documentary about the old telephone corporation days!
lines.style: Quiet voice climbing with pride, extra careful over the long word, ending bright.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバンドのヴォーカル時代の写真を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Dad showed me photos from his days as a vocalist in a band, you know.
lines.style: Amused fond disclosure, slowing on vocalist like it's still hard to believe, warmly conspiratorial.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと長調と短調の聞き分け遊びしたよ
lines.en: Dad and I played a game guessing if songs were major or minor!
lines.style: Soft eager rush, stumbling sweetly over the music words, proud of the new game.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと小麦粉でパンを焼く予定よ
lines.en: We're planning to bake bread with Dad — real flour, the whole business.
lines.style: Practical brightness with an indulgent sigh underneath, pace easy, warmth landing on bread.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとエッセー、つまりエッセー集を書店で買ったよ
lines.en: Me and Dad bought a book of essays at the bookstore!
lines.style: Simple glowing report, small pause before essays, finishing with a satisfied bounce.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが豪快に運転される姿を見たわ
lines.en: I saw the way Dad drives — bold as anything, honestly.
lines.style: Dry maternal amusement, eye-rolling tone on bold, softened by an affectionate landing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんから蛍光マーカーセットを頂いたよ
lines.en: And Dad gave me a whole set of highlighter markers!
lines.style: Bright happy finish, loudest word is markers, joy spilling past his usual quietness.
